title: Four selectable Sleeper portraits must match playable characters
summary: Founder explicitly confirmed the four original Sleeper reference designs are character-select portraits. Each selected portrait MUST map to the SAME corresponding playable Frame (A-D) visually, with distinct helmet silhouette, purple vs cyan lights, cloak/scarf/damage and armor. The four newly generated 2x2 static front/side/side/back character turnarounds are founder-approved VISUAL TARGETS, not yet proven engine-ready pixel sprites: source renders 1254x1254 RGBA with soft alpha, 150k+ colors, no animation. Preserve identity mapping with stable IDs and save/load. Next steps: pixel cleanup, target size tested in mobile engine, separate direction/pivots, static QA, idle/walk animation, runtime test. Stop spending primary study hours on generic Unit09 block drawings. Public warehouse stores methods ONLY, not source/derived private art.
